open_findings.title: Restrict script capabilities to reviewed schema only
open_findings.evidence: Allowed diagnostic memory-reference executescript attaches live authority, commits a business-user revocation, and detaches while process remains held; no new operation intent is created.
open_findings.required_change: Allow exact reviewed schema scripts/statements only in matching initialization and memory roles; refuse scripts in backup destination and ATTACH/other arbitrary SQL everywhere.

open_findings.title: Bind constructor options to the exact authority and role
open_findings.evidence: validate=False permits online reads from a database with invalid user_version; guard A can protect an Owner rooted at cloned B; even with matching guard/root A, path override to cloned B returns business rows under the wrong file lock.
open_findings.required_change: Require binding validation for normal file roles; require resolved guard.root == owner.root; allow explicit file path override only for fresh backup destination. Memory roles must not accept a file path.

open_findings.title: Invalidate read capability when its snapshot ends
open_findings.evidence: readonly rollback ends validated snapshot but leaves execute usable. After a raw synthetic writer changes user_version to 0, the same owner returns business rows and observes version 0 without revalidation.
open_findings.required_change: Reader transaction ending belongs to owner cleanup. Refuse or permanently invalidate read use after public rollback; do not silently start unvalidated observations.

open_findings.title: Terminate diagnostic allowance after any owner failure
open_findings.evidence: Inside one diagnostic context, catching a first guard-proof open failure permits a second proof owner/open and successful rows. _ownership_diagnostic_used is true but does not invalidate the active allowance.
open_findings.required_change: Latch diagnostic failure per existing token before another owner/statement can open, including errors caught within the diagnostic context. Preserve single original-role note and forbid helper retries.

open_findings.title: Retain failed native effect acknowledgements even if caller catches them
open_findings.evidence: Caught native write acknowledgement error permits automatic context commit and ready status. Caught post-commit acknowledgement error triggers a second native commit and ready status. Caught backup acknowledgement error permits both source and destination scopes to exit successfully.
open_findings.required_change: Invalidate owner effect/commit/backup success paths after native effect acknowledgement failures, retain the original exception, prevent later effect or commit retry, and let existing token uncertainty handling run. Keep clean read/business refusals distinct; preserve partial backup output.

open_findings.title: Reject ambiguous projections before bounded materialization
open_findings.evidence: SELECT subject, zeroblob(1000000) AS subject FROM users returns a one-million-byte bytes field under the registered text <=80 subject name. Both generated preflight checks resolve to the first duplicate name.
open_findings.required_change: Reject duplicate/ambiguous result names before payload fetch or validate every projected position unambiguously.
